jobs.title: Why Is Earth Tilted?
jobs.description:
Earth leans 23.5 degrees - most likely because a giant crash knocked it over when it was young. That tilt, not our distance from the Sun, gives us seasons. In fact, Earth is closest to the Sun in January!

#space #earth #seasons #science #shorts
